summary: lululemon athletica inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Cooperation Agreement with founder Dennis J. Chip Wilson and related entities, resolving a potential board challenge. Under the terms, the board will appoint Laura Gentile and Marc Maurer as independent directors immediately after the 2026 annual meeting, add a third new independent director with apparel expertise by October 1, 2026, and have one incumbent director not stand for reelection at the 2027 annual meeting. The company will support Wilson's proposal to declassify the board. The agreement includes voting commitments, standstill, and non-disparagement provisions. It terminates 30 days before the 2028 annual meeting nomination deadline. This represents a forced board refreshment to address activist pressure, with the outcome hinging on stockholder votes at upcoming meetings.
